test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Local
solution: The correct answer is **"Foreign."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Local"** means something or someone belonging to a particular place or area. (स्‍थानीय) • **Example**: *This is a **local**__ newspaper.* • **"Foreign"** means something or someone coming from or belonging to a different country or place. (स्‍वदेश से भिन्‍न देश का या उससे संबंधित; विदेशी) __ • **Example**: *She belongs to a **foreign**__ country.* • Therefore, **foreign** is the most appropriate antonym of **local**. • The correct answer is Option 2. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Familiar** means something or someone well-known or recognized. (सुपरिचित; जाना-पहचाना) • **Frozen** means something or someone turned into ice or solidified due to extreme cold. ((खाद्य पदार्थ) सुरक्षित रखने के लिए कम तापमान पर भंडारण) • **Torrid** means something or someone very hot or dry, usually referring to weather or climate. (विशेषकर प्रेम तथा कामुकता की भावना से पूर्ण; कामुक) 15f:T635, The correct answer is** "were shifted to another hospital that same evening as this hospital caught fire."**
